evidence.notes: Security.stripInaccessible strips fields for local records using the current user's object and field permissions.
Security.stripInaccessible reports the local removed-field map through SObjectAccessDecision.getRemovedFields().
Security.stripInaccessible reports the local modified-index set through SObjectAccessDecision.getModifiedIndexes().

source.content: @isTest private class DataRuntimeSObjectAccessDecisionTest { @isTest static void stripInaccessibleReturnsDecisionDetails() { List<Account> rows = new List<Account>{new Account(Name = 'Probe')}; SObjectAccessDecision decision = Security.stripInaccessible(AccessType.READABLE, rows, false); System.assertEquals(1, decision.getRecords().size()); System.assertEquals(0, decision.getRemovedFields().size()); System.assertEquals(0, decision.getModifiedIndexes().size()); } }
